title: 章四 真实

content_zh:
李察苦苦忍耐着，从小锻炼出来的坚韧和好强在这一刻得到显现，竟然真的坚持到了所有的阴影都进入身体。当吸收完最后一缕阴影后，李察的精神终于一松，眼前一片模糊，女神的神殿则逐渐淡去。
在模糊的视野中，李察看到了妈妈那美丽而关切的脸，他终于放松下来，失去了意识。
“我拿到了两项能力，妈妈会为我自豪吧！”在飘飘荡荡的黑暗中，李察下意识的想着。
阁楼上，月之女神的祭坛上出现了一条明显的裂纹，这座稀有的祭坛竟然在仪式中损坏。伊莲则是脸色苍白，唇边流下一缕鲜血，她却浑然不觉，只是疯狂察看着李察的全身各处，待看到他的身体完好如初，并没有受到任何损伤时这才放下一点心事。可是当她发现李察眉心处盘旋着一小片阴影时，脸色再次大变。
阁楼中有灯火和月光，而李察又是仰躺着的，无论哪个光源都不会在李察的眉心处留下阴影。那一小片阴影如雾如烟，缓缓游动着，却是凝聚不散。这是普通人根本分辨不出的阴影，然而身上还留存着第五弦月力量的伊莲却看得见。她颤抖着，伸手去触摸，指尖上传来隐约的冰凉和刺痛感觉，那是暗影能量和艾露西娅的神力冲突带来的感觉。
“暗影生物？！”伊莲失声叫着。她咬了咬牙，再次将手指探入到李察眉心的暗影中，心中默念着早已变得陌生的祈祷文。那是伊莲当年也未能掌握的神术预见，可是这一刻她的心早已乱了，在她的知识中，只有这个神术才能解开李察眉心那一片暗影的来历。哪怕希望再渺茫，她都必须试一试。
自从失去了大祭祀的身份后，她也就失去了女神的眷顾和全部的神术。本来是绝望之下的胡乱举动，可是伊莲没有想到，神术预见却意外的成功了。
在伊莲的眼前出现了一幅画卷，那是无尽的虚无与黑暗，只有混沌的能量，根本没有月亮，也没有星辰。在混沌中，一片片巨大的阴影正在缓缓游动着，看似杂乱无章的运行轨迹最后却汇聚到一条轨道上，直指最终那个明晰的目的地，那就是小李察！
画卷一闪而逝，短暂的预见已耗尽了她全部的力量，让她连动一动手指的的力气都没有。就算体力充沛，所看到的一切也让她再一次感觉到深深的绝望。
暗影并不同于黑暗，那是没有实质存在的一种能量，天然具备空间属性。暗影生物有无数的种类，它们大多数在位面之间游荡，漫无目的。各位面之间的混乱能量就是它们的天然养料。它们狡猾、危险而强大，所以也是法师们的热爱并恐惧着的物种。阴影召唤已经是一个很成熟的法术，从六级可以一直强化到九级。但是这一法术有着很小的机率失败，那时召唤出的暗影生物将会失去控制，而拥有魔力的法师在它们眼中是最美味的食物之一。所以大陆上每年都会听到几起法师被召唤来的暗影生物吞噬的事故。
盘踞在小李察眉心的暗影有着生命的迹象，却并非完整的生命体。它本身所蕴含的暗影能量并不强大，只要一个普通的祭祀就能够将其净化。它的作用其实类似于灯塔，在无限复杂的位面宇宙间标定出一个位置，召唤大群的暗影生命进入这一位面，正是伊莲在预见中看到的景象。现在，就算把这片暗影抹除净化也晚了，那群恐怖的暗影生命得到了座标，已经起程。
而小李察，就是它们进入这一位面的座标和锚点。
当大群的暗影生物开始冲击位面时，小李察只有两种可能的结局，要么是被剧烈的能量冲突毁灭，不然则会被最强大的暗影生物附身，永远的失去身体的控制权。那时的他，将会成为容纳暗影生物族群的容器。
谁也说不清位面间的法则，横渡的暗影生物可能需要数百年的时间完成旅程，也有可能一个月后就抵达终点。

content_en:
Richard endured it hard, and the tenacity and strength he had trained since childhood were revealed at this moment, and he actually persisted until all the shadows entered his body. After absorbing the last ray of shadow, Richard's spirit finally relaxed, his vision became blurry, and the temple of the goddess gradually faded away.
In his blurred vision, Richard saw his mother's beautiful and concerned face. He finally relaxed and lost consciousness.
"I have obtained two abilities, my mother will be proud of me!" In the drifting darkness, Richard thought subconsciously.
In the attic, an obvious crack appeared on the altar of the Moon Goddess. This rare altar was actually damaged during the ceremony. Elaine's face was pale, and a wisp of blood flowed from her lips, but she didn't notice it at all. She just frantically looked at every part of Richard's body. When she saw that his body was intact and without any damage, she relaxed a little. But when she discovered a small shadow hovering between Richard's eyebrows, her expression changed drastically again.
There were lights and moonlight in the attic, and Richard was lying on his back. No matter which light source was used, it would not leave a shadow between Richard's eyebrows. The small shadow was like mist, swimming slowly, but it stayed together. This is a shadow that ordinary people cannot distinguish at all, but Elaine, who still retains the power of the fifth quarter moon, can see it. She trembled, stretched out her hand to touch, and felt a vague cold and tingling sensation on her fingertips. It was the feeling caused by the conflict between the shadow energy and Elusia's divine power.
"Shadow creatures?!" Elaine cried out. She gritted her teeth and once again inserted her fingers into the shadow between Richard's eyebrows, silently reciting a prayer that had become unfamiliar in her heart. It was a magical foresight that Elaine had not been able to master back then, but at this moment her mind was already in confusion. In her knowledge, only this magical technique could unravel the origin of the shadow between Richard's eyebrows. No matter how slim the hope was, she had to give it a try.
Since she lost her identity as a high priest, she also lost the favor of the goddess and all her magical powers. It was originally a random act out of desperation, but Elaine didn't expect that the divine foresight was unexpectedly successful.
A picture appeared in front of Elaine's eyes. It was endless nothingness and darkness, only chaotic energy. There was no moon or stars at all. In the chaos, huge shadows were swimming slowly, and the seemingly chaotic trajectories finally converged on one track, pointing directly to the final clear destination, which was Little Richard!
The picture flashed away, and the brief foresight had exhausted all her strength, leaving her without the strength to even move a finger. Even though she had plenty of energy, everything she saw made her feel deep despair again.
Shadow is not different from darkness. It is a kind of energy that has no physical existence and naturally has spatial attributes. There are countless types of shadow creatures, most of which wander aimlessly between planes. The chaotic energy between the planes is their natural nourishment. They are cunning, dangerous and powerful, so they are also a species that mages love and fear. Shadow Summoning is already a very mature spell that can be enhanced from level six to level nine. However, this spell has a small chance of failure. At that time, the summoned shadow creatures will lose control, and mages with magical powers are one of the most delicious foods in their eyes. Therefore, every year on the mainland, we hear about several accidents in which mages are devoured by summoned shadow creatures.
The shadow lingering between Little Richard's brows showed signs of life, but it was not a complete life form. The shadow energy contained in it itself is not powerful, and only an ordinary sacrifice can purify it. Its function is actually similar to a lighthouse. It marks a position in the infinitely complex universe of planes and summons a large group of shadow beings to enter this plane. This is exactly what Elaine saw in her vision. Now, even if this shadow is erased and purified, it is too lateNow, that group of terrifying shadow beings have obtained their coordinates and have already set off.
And Little Richard is the coordinate and anchor point for them to enter this plane.
When large groups of shadow creatures begin to impact the plane, Little Richard has only two possible endings, either he will be destroyed by the violent energy conflict, or he will be possessed by the most powerful shadow creature and lose control of his body forever. At that time, he will become the container to accommodate the shadow creature group.
No one can explain the laws between the planes. The shadow creatures crossing may take hundreds of years to complete the journey, or they may reach the destination in a month.
